editorial_plan.report_thesis: The findings show that app performance is not one growth story: signals vary by vertical, segment and measure, so decisions should be grounded in the specific cohort and metric.

themes.theme: Global e-commerce signals diverged by measure in 2025: installs fell 10% year over year while sessions increased 5%. Reported CPI shifted from $1.00 in 2024 to $0.98 in 2025 overall, but rose from $1.44 to $2.26 for Deal discovery and declined from $0.99 to $0.88 for Marketplace & classifieds.

Global finance-app measures also diverged: in 2025, installs fell 4% year over year while sessions rose 21%; session length increased 8% to 7.18 minutes, while day-0 sessions per user declined from 1.52 in 2024 to 1.48 in 2025. These are distinct measures of finance-app activity, not a single directional signal.
LATAM led regional finance-app growth in 2024–2025, with installs growing 76% and sessions growing 57% year over year; the chart does not state underlying counts or denominators.
Globally, in the 2024–2025 year-over-year comparison, casino installs increased 22% and sessions decreased 5%, while slots installs increased 46% and sessions decreased 5%.
Most organizations report low or moderate GenAI maturity, while a small group with advanced deployment reportedly achieved efficiency gains of over 20%.
Global gaming-app all-game retention changed minimally from 2024 to 2025; reported rates were 27% on day 1, 13% on day 7, 8% on day 14 and 5% on day 30.
The page reports more than 112.1 billion app downloads in 2025; the download figure's geography is not specified.

summary.tldr: In 2025, global e-commerce app installs fell 10% year over year while sessions increased 5%, a divergence across the two measures.
summary.card_tldr_compact: Global e-commerce app sessions rose 5% in 2025 as installs fell 10% year over year.
summary.executive_summary: In 2025, global e-commerce app installs fell 10% year over year while sessions increased 5%. For global e-commerce apps, reported CPI (USD per install) was $1.00 in 2024 and $0.98 in 2025 overall; for Deal discovery, $1.44 in 2024 and $2.26 in 2025; for Marketplace & classifieds, $0.99 in 2024 and $0.88 in 2025. In 2025, global finance app installs fell 4% year over year, while sessions rose 21%. Globally, finance-app session length increased 8% to 7.18 minutes in 2025. Global day-0 finance-app sessions per user declined year over year from 1.52 in 2024 to 1.48 in 2025.

insights_final.text: In 2025, global e-commerce app installs fell 10% year over year while sessions increased 5%. Reported global e-commerce CPI (USD per install) declined from $1.00 in 2024 to $0.98 in 2025 overall; Deal discovery CPI rose from $1.44 to $2.26, while Marketplace & classifieds CPI fell from $0.99 to $0.88.

expert_comment: In the 2025 year-over-year comparison, global e-commerce app installs fell 10% while sessions rose 5%; global finance-app installs fell 4% while sessions rose 21%. In the global 2024–2025 year-over-year comparison, casino installs increased 22% and casino sessions decreased 5%; slots installs increased 46% and slots sessions decreased 5%. Across these verticals and subverticals, install movement and session movement do not form a single aligned growth signal. MarketLense recommends that leaders assess installs and sessions separately within each vertical and subvertical when using these findings to set growth priorities.
linkedin_post:
Global e-commerce app installs fell 10% year over year in 2025, while sessions increased 5% year over year.

Installs and sessions tell different directional stories.

At MarketLense, if assessing global e-commerce activity, we would keep these measures distinct rather than rely on one headline metric.

decision_brief.strategic_context: In 2025, global e-commerce app installs fell 10% year over year while sessions increased 5%, a divergence across the two measures.
decision_implications: The overall install and session measures diverge, while CPI direction also differs by category.
Finance-app signals diverged across installs, sessions, session length, and day-0 sessions per user.
Both reported measures show growth, but underlying counts and denominators are not stated.
priority_moves: Review installs, sessions, and CPI by category rather than relying on one overall e-commerce measure.
Review acquisition and engagement measures separately, retaining the day-0 per-user basis for that metric.
Validate absolute volumes before translating the growth rates into regional allocation decisions.

items.recommendation: Review installs, sessions, and CPI by category rather than relying on one overall e-commerce measure.
Review acquisition and engagement measures separately, retaining the day-0 per-user basis for that metric.
Validate absolute volumes before translating the growth rates into regional allocation decisions.
Review installs and sessions separately for casino and slots.
Distinguish advanced-deployment outcomes from broader maturity reports when evaluating GenAI results.
Benchmark retention at the same post-install intervals against the reported all-game profile.
Use it only in comparisons with aligned geographic scope.

claim_ledgers.claim_text: Global e-commerce app sessions rose 5% in 2025 as installs fell 10% year over year.

For global e-commerce apps, reported CPI (USD per install) was $1.00 in 2024 and $0.98 in 2025 overall; for Deal discovery, $1.44 in 2024 and $2.26 in 2025; for Marketplace & classifieds, $0.99 in 2024 and $0.88 in 2025.
In 2025, global finance app installs fell 4% year over year, while sessions rose 21%.
Globally, finance-app session length increased 8% to 7.18 minutes in 2025.
Global day-0 finance-app sessions per user declined year over year from 1.52 in 2024 to 1.48 in 2025.

In 2025, global e-commerce app installs fell 10% year over year while sessions increased 5%. Reported global e-commerce CPI (USD per install) declined from $1.00 in 2024 to $0.98 in 2025 overall; Deal discovery CPI rose from $1.44 to $2.26, while Marketplace & classifieds CPI fell from $0.99 to $0.88.

In 2025, global finance-app installs fell 4% year over year while sessions rose 21%. Globally, finance-app session length increased 8% to 7.18 minutes in 2025, while day-0 sessions per user declined year over year from 1.52 in 2024 to 1.48 in 2025.
LATAM led regional finance-app growth in 2024–2025: installs grew 76% and sessions grew 57% year over year. The chart does not state underlying counts or denominators.
Globally, in the 2024–2025 year-over-year comparison, casino installs were +22% and sessions were −5%; slots installs were +46% and sessions were −5%.
Most organizations report low or moderate GenAI maturity, while a small group with advanced deployment reportedly achieved efficiency gains of over 20%.
Global gaming-app all-game retention changed minimally from 2024 to 2025; reported rates were 27% on day 1, 13% on day 7, 8% on day 14, and 5% on day 30.
The page reports more than 112.1 billion app downloads in 2025; the figure's geography is not specified.

source_truth_notes_by_page.9: Under “Generative AI enters its utility phase,” the page explicitly pairs most organizations reporting low or moderate GenAI maturity with a small group with advanced deployment reportedly achieving efficiency gains over 20%. The stated relationship supports the claim’s contrast between broad maturity levels and the reported outcome for the smaller advanced-deployment group. No timeframe, geography, or denominator is specified.

planned_themes: Global e-commerce signals diverged by measure in 2025: installs fell 10% year over year while sessions increased 5%. Reported CPI shifted from $1.00 in 2024 to $0.98 in 2025 overall, but rose from $1.44 to $2.26 for Deal discovery and declined from $0.99 to $0.88 for Marketplace & classifieds.

Global finance-app measures also diverged: in 2025, installs fell 4% year over year while sessions rose 21%; session length increased 8% to 7.18 minutes, while day-0 sessions per user declined from 1.52 in 2024 to 1.48 in 2025. These are distinct measures of finance-app activity, not a single directional signal.
LATAM led regional finance-app growth in 2024–2025, with installs growing 76% and sessions growing 57% year over year; the chart does not state underlying counts or denominators.
Globally, in the 2024–2025 year-over-year comparison, casino installs increased 22% and sessions decreased 5%, while slots installs increased 46% and sessions decreased 5%.
Most organizations report low or moderate GenAI maturity, while a small group with advanced deployment reportedly achieved efficiency gains of over 20%.
Global gaming-app all-game retention changed minimally from 2024 to 2025; reported rates were 27% on day 1, 13% on day 7, 8% on day 14 and 5% on day 30.
The page reports more than 112.1 billion app downloads in 2025; the download figure's geography is not specified.
